operator_reaffirmations.scope: Include a strategy that is itself demonstrably bad and causing losses, not only technical defects, within the standing evidence-backed remediation authority.

authorization: The agent may implement and deploy evidence-backed corrective changes without requesting a second approval when a confirmed technical defect or a demonstrably adverse strategy is causing or is reasonably likely to cause avoidable capital loss or materially reduce realized profitability.
intent: Stop avoidable technical or strategy-driven capital bleeding while retaining rigorous evidence, bounded risk, reversible deployment, and complete traceability.
inherited_technical_authority: All technical-remediation categories, evidence requirements, deployment invariants, and rollback duties in v51-standing-technical-remediation-authorization-v1 remain authorized unless narrowed below.
authorized_strategy_remediation_without_: pause or downgrade an adverse route to report-only so it cannot open new positions
remove an adverse strategy or asset route from live authority while preserving its historical evidence
reduce leverage, margin allocation, notional sizing, or concurrent exposure for an adverse route

correct, retune, or replace entry, exit, regime, priority, or holding logic when compatible evidence demonstrates that the approved strategy contract itself has negative after-cost expectancy or a materially inferior loss-capture profile

deploy a separately identified replacement only after it passes realistic friction, chronological development, untouched out-of-sample or forward validation, concentration sensitivity, and live-execution feasibility checks

close an affected live position reduce-only when the strategy assumption supporting continued exposure has been empirically invalidated and preserving the position has the worse evidence-backed expected outcome
roll back to the last verified strategy revision when a newly deployed revision materially degrades compatible live behavior
strategy_adversity_evidence_required: route-compatible live or forward outcomes with actual or realistically stressed fees, funding, slippage, latency, and liquidity
sample-size and uncertainty assessment that distinguishes normal variance from likely negative edge
entry, exit, side, regime, time, and opportunity-cost attribution sufficient to identify the failing mechanism
comparison against the active v51 contract, taking no action, and any proposed replacement
chronological folds, untouched out-of-sample or forward evidence, and explicit look-ahead, leakage, selection, and overfitting checks where historical testing is used
largest-winner and largest-loser removal, drawdown, loss clustering, and portfolio concentration sensitivity
technical completeness proving the loss pattern is not primarily caused by data, routing, execution, accounting, or telemetry defects
a falsifiable causal diagnosis and a bounded corrective delta
not_sufficient_to_label_a_strategy_bad: one or two losses without contradictory implementation evidence
an open position moving against entry while its approved exit and risk contract remain intact
low trade frequency during a window without the strategy's intended market conditions
readiness percentage, model confidence, or regime label alone
a backtest winner selected from many uncorrected trials
gross PnL that becomes negative only after omitting known fees, funding, slippage, or liquidity constraints
post-hoc side, asset, regime, or time filtering without a separately frozen validation window

response_ladder.inconclusive_or_normal_variance: Continue the frozen route and collect the minimum additional evidence; do not change live authority.
response_ladder.probable_negative_edge_but_replacement_u: Stop new entries on the affected route or downgrade it to report-only; preserve current protective exits and continue diagnosis.
response_ladder.confirmed_negative_edge_with_validated_c: Deploy the minimal retune, replacement, or removal with a new identity, prechange backup, explicit rollback, and poststart acceptance.
response_ladder.active_position_supported_by_invalidated: Use reduce-only closure if current authoritative evidence shows continued exposure is the materially worse expected action; otherwise preserve the configured protective exit while disabling future entries.
response_ladder.new_revision_degrades_after_deployment: Fail closed, stop new entries, restore protection, and roll back at the earliest safe reconciled boundary.

still_requires_specific_approval: increase leverage, margin fraction, notional sizing, concentration, or portfolio risk beyond the active approved contract
add a new asset or live strategy that has not passed the full validation contract
replace a route with a candidate selected only for higher backtest profit
remove a correctly functioning route solely because it did not trade during a short window
override a protected position solely to lock a small unrealized profit or avoid ordinary configured variance
deployment_invariants: freeze the evidence window and exact active identity before selection
create and verify a recoverable prechange backup
preserve or tighten protection during transition; never leave exposure naked
fail closed on unresolved venue, account, position, order, profile, source, or accounting identity
use a distinct strategy/profile identity for behavior-changing corrections
run focused unit, integration, replay, configuration, preflight, and poststart acceptance proportional to the changed path
verify actual venue orders, leverage, margin, stops, fills, fees, funding, and TUI telemetry after deployment
journal the evidence, causal diagnosis, alternatives, exact delta, rollback, outcome, confidence, and falsifier
report every standing-authority action and current exposure to the operator immediately

HYPE_compression_pullback.evidence: one closed v51 stop loss and one protected aligned short still open; the open path recovered from -$6.99 gross to positive while remaining directionally supported
HYPE_compression_pullback.action: continue the frozen exit and score the lifecycle only after exact close reconciliation

ETH_and_SOL_range_onset.evidence: missing-hourly-cross non-overlapping counterfactuals are negative after estimated friction across 5/15/30/60-minute horizons
ETH_and_SOL_range_onset.action: retain gates and await attributable eligible lifecycles

SP500_and_SPCX_pressure.evidence: 23 current-run decisions per symbol and no directional onset or eligible action
SP500_and_SPCX_pressure.action: continue source-native capture; low frequency alone is not a removal trigger

BTC_routes.evidence: Hulk has two directional evaluations and Sweep has no directional evaluation in the reviewed prefix

falsifier: If compatible evidence cannot distinguish negative edge from normal variance, regime mismatch, technical failure, or execution drag, the standing strategy-remediation authority does not trigger. If the operator narrows this scope, update the authorization before further use.
